info.title: Campaign Monitor Universal API
info.description: Email marketing platform for managing clients, lists, subscribers, campaigns, segments, templates, and reporting through the Campaign Monitor API.

post.description: Adds a subscriber to a Campaign Monitor list, or updates an existing one.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

resubscribe.description: Whether to resubscribe the subscriber if previously unsubscribed.

response.description: Subscriber email address returned by Campaign Monitor when the subscriber is added.
